description_en: Changes the virtual IP address (VIP) that is used to connect to an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-vip --db-cluster-id am-2ze8mbuai9700000 --vpc-id vpc-bp1at5ze0t5u3xtqn0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1aadw9k19x6cis90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterVip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC ID。

VPC所在地域与集群属于同一地域
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。
传入的新虚拟交换机必须与集群属于同一个可用区
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The internal or public endpoint for which the server certificate needs to be created or updated
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id
